cinematic.director.title: Scene Director
cinematic.director.description: Review one scene as a complete directing contract before creating shots.
cinematic.director.purposeValue: Mira chooses to wait, shifting the story from avoidance to hope.
cinematic.director.cameraValue: Eye-level 50mm coverage with one restrained push toward recognition.
cinematic.director.blockingValue: Mira holds foreground left; Noah enters deep background on the platform axis.
cinematic.director.lightingValue: Cool station ambience balanced by one warm practical near the waiting area.
cinematic.director.performanceValue: Restrained breath, delayed eye contact, no broad smile.
cinematic.director.audioValue: Distant train, room tone and a single paper movement.
cinematic.director.continuityValue: Letter in right hand; coat closed; hair remains behind left shoulder.
cinematic.director.transitionValue: Cut on the approaching headlight into Noah's entrance.
cinematic.director.operationDescription: Creates structured scene direction and a first shot proposal.

cinematic.storyboard.fixture.revealActio: The last train enters the platform

cinematic.produce.promptFixture: Mira holds beneath the platform clock as the camera makes a restrained slow push-in. Preserve her identity, wardrobe, eyeline and cool station light while one warm practical remains behind her.

cinematic.cast.noahPerformance: Open posture and measured approach. Hold warmth without a broad smile until the final beat.
